title: Foundations & Primers
summary: Surveys, primers, classic post-training lineages, data documentation, and evaluation background for readers entering the field.
summary_zh: 面向初入该领域读者的综述、入门材料、经典后训练谱系、数据文档与评测背景。
reader_promise: Use this track when you need the map before the terrain: vocabulary, taxonomies, historical lineages, and recurring audit questions.
reader_promise_zh: 当你需要先看地图再进地形时用这个方向：术语、分类法、历史谱系，以及反复出现的审计问题。

subfields.name: 🧭 Post-training surveys
subfields.focus: field-level maps of post-training, reasoning models, and data-centric LLM practice
subfields.focus_zh: 后训练、推理模型与以数据为中心的大模型实践的领域地图
subfields.key_risk: survey taxonomy hides concrete data objects
subfields.key_risk_zh: 综述的分类法会掩盖具体的数据对象

subfields.name: 🧠 Reasoning LLM surveys
subfields.focus: reasoning-model lineages, claims, and recurring evaluation patterns
subfields.focus_zh: 推理模型的技术谱系、主张与反复出现的评测范式
subfields.key_risk: model-centric framing obscures data and verifier details
subfields.key_risk_zh: 以模型为中心的叙述会遮蔽数据与验证器细节

subfields.name: 📦 Data documentation / datasheets
subfields.name_zh: 数据文档与数据说明书
subfields.focus: datasheets, data statements, lineage, license, and release metadata
subfields.focus_zh: datasheet、data statement、谱系、许可与发布元数据
subfields.key_risk: reusable data lacks provenance or consent context
subfields.key_risk_zh: 可复用的数据缺少来源溯源或授权语境

subfields.name: 🧪 RLHF / reward-model surveys
subfields.focus: background linking preference data, reward models, and reasoning rewards
subfields.focus_zh: 串联偏好数据、奖励模型与推理奖励的背景材料
subfields.key_risk: generic alignment lessons are over-applied to verifiable reasoning
subfields.key_risk_zh: 通用对齐经验被过度套用到可验证推理上
keywords: reinforcement learning from human feedback survey

subfields.name: 🌐 Agent data / tool-use surveys
subfields.name_zh: 智能体数据与工具调用综述
subfields.focus: orientation for tools, web tasks, OS tasks, and repository agents
subfields.focus_zh: 工具、网页任务、操作系统任务与仓库级智能体的入门导览
subfields.key_risk: agent traces are treated as transcripts rather than replayable episodes
subfields.key_risk_zh: 智能体轨迹被当成聊天记录，而不是可回放的 episode

subfields.name: 🧯 Contamination / evaluation surveys
subfields.focus: reproducibility, contamination, model collapse, and benchmark refresh
subfields.focus_zh: 可复现性、数据污染、模型崩塌与基准刷新
subfields.key_risk: benchmark deltas are accepted without overlap checks
subfields.key_risk_zh: 基准分数的提升未经重叠检查就被采信

title: Instruction / Demo / Rationale
title_zh: 指令、示范与思维链数据
summary: Instruction-response examples, human demonstrations, synthetic instructions, rationales, chain-of-thought traces, and teacher-written reasoning targets.
summary_zh: 指令—回答样例、人工示范、合成指令、推理过程、思维链轨迹，以及教师写出的推理目标。
reader_promise: Use this track to understand how reasoning behavior is serialized before preference, verifier, or environment feedback is added.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向理解：在加入偏好、验证器或环境反馈之前，推理行为是如何被序列化成数据的。

subfields.name: 🧱 Instruction tuning / SFT data
subfields.name_zh: 指令微调与 SFT 数据
subfields.focus: instruction-response examples, demonstrations, and target behavior records
subfields.focus_zh: 指令—回答样例、示范，以及目标行为记录
subfields.key_risk: prompt sources and mixture weights are hidden
subfields.key_risk_zh: 题目来源与混配权重被隐去

subfields.name: 🧑‍🏫 Human demonstrations
subfields.focus: human-written solutions, explanations, rationales, and expert demonstrations
subfields.focus_zh: 人写的解法、解释、思路与专家示范
subfields.key_risk: human trace policy and expertise are unclear
subfields.key_risk_zh: 人工轨迹的撰写规范与专业背景不清

subfields.name: 🤖 Synthetic instruction data
subfields.focus: self-instruct, teacher-generated tasks, and synthetic instruction mixtures
subfields.focus_zh: self-instruct、教师生成任务与合成指令混配
subfields.key_risk: synthetic prompts collapse diversity or inherit teacher artifacts
subfields.key_risk_zh: 合成题目会压缩多样性或继承教师的偏好痕迹

subfields.name: 🧠 Chain-of-thought / rationale data
subfields.name_zh: 思维链与推理过程数据
subfields.focus: rationales, CoT traces, self-consistency, and reasoning-style supervision
subfields.focus_zh: 推理过程、CoT 轨迹、自一致性与推理风格监督
subfields.key_risk: trace style is mistaken for faithful reasoning
subfields.key_risk_zh: 把轨迹的文体误当成真实的推理忠实度

subfields.name: 🔁 Self-training / STaR
subfields.focus: bootstrapped traces, self-training, critique loops, and filtered self-improvement
subfields.focus_zh: 自举轨迹、自训练、批判循环与经过筛选的自我改进
subfields.key_risk: feedback loop repeats hidden errors or shortcuts
subfields.key_risk_zh: 反馈回路会不断复制隐藏的错误或捷径

subfields.name: ✂️ Long/short CoT distillation
subfields.focus: teacher long traces, distilled short traces, and reasoning compression
subfields.focus_zh: 教师长轨迹、蒸馏后的短轨迹与推理压缩
subfields.key_risk: distillation loses uncertainty and failed attempts
subfields.key_risk_zh: 蒸馏会丢掉不确定性与失败尝试

title: Preference & Reward Feedback
summary: Human preferences, AI feedback, reward models, DPO-style pairs, scalar rewards, critiques, and rubric-conditioned feedback records.
summary_zh: 人类偏好、AI 反馈、奖励模型、DPO 式偏好对、标量奖励、批判，以及基于评分标准的反馈记录。
reader_promise: Use this track to compare preference and reward signals before they become training objectives or evaluation proxies.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向对比各类偏好与奖励信号——在它们变成训练目标或评测替代指标之前。

subfields.name: 🤝 Human preference data / RLHF
subfields.focus: human comparison data, helpful/harmless feedback, and RLHF reward targets
subfields.focus_zh: 人工对比数据、有用/无害反馈与 RLHF 奖励目标
subfields.key_risk: annotator assumptions and disagreement are hidden
subfields.key_risk_zh: 标注者的假设与分歧被隐去

subfields.name: ⚖️ DPO / preference optimization
subfields.focus: pairwise data used directly for preference optimization
subfields.focus_zh: 直接用于偏好优化的成对数据
subfields.key_risk: preference pairs are reused outside collection context
subfields.key_risk_zh: 偏好对被脱离采集语境复用

subfields.name: 🎚️ Scalar reward / ORM data
subfields.name_zh: 标量奖励与结果奖励数据
subfields.focus: outcome reward labels, scalar scores, and trained reward-model targets
subfields.focus_zh: 结果奖励标签、标量分数与训练奖励模型的目标
subfields.key_risk: scalar reward hides why an answer is better
subfields.key_risk_zh: 标量奖励掩盖了「为什么这个答案更好」

subfields.name: 🤖 RLAIF / synthetic feedback
subfields.focus: model-generated preferences, critiques, and constitutional feedback
subfields.focus_zh: 模型生成的偏好、批判与 constitutional 反馈
subfields.key_risk: synthetic judge behavior is treated as human preference
subfields.key_risk_zh: 把合成评审的行为当作人类偏好

subfields.name: 🧪 Reward-model benchmarks
subfields.focus: rewardbench-style evaluation data and reward-model stress tests
subfields.focus_zh: RewardBench 式评测数据与奖励模型压力测试
subfields.key_risk: benchmark preference does not predict downstream training value
subfields.key_risk_zh: 基准上的偏好不能预测下游训练价值

subfields.name: 🧾 Rubric-conditioned rewards
subfields.focus: rubric scores, critique-plus-score records, and domain-specific reward signals
subfields.focus_zh: rubric 分数、批判加评分的记录与领域专用奖励信号
subfields.key_risk: rubric wording becomes an exploitable reward channel
subfields.key_risk_zh: rubric 的措辞会变成可被利用的奖励通道

title: Programmatic Verification
title_zh: 可程序验证的结果数据
summary: Math answers, code execution, unit tests, proof checkers, symbolic predicates, answer extraction, and verifier robustness studies.
summary_zh: 数学答案、代码执行、单元测试、证明检查器、符号判定、答案抽取，以及验证器鲁棒性研究。
reader_promise: Use this track for the cleanest verifier-bearing reasoning records: final answers or artifacts checked by code, rules, tests, or formal systems.
reader_promise_zh: 这里是最干净的一类带验证器推理记录：最终答案或产物由代码、规则、测试或形式系统来检查。

subfields.name: 📐 Math answer-verifiable data
subfields.focus: math problems, final answers, solution traces, and answer checkers
subfields.focus_zh: 数学题、最终答案、解题轨迹与答案检查器
subfields.key_risk: answer extraction and normalization inflate scores
subfields.key_risk_zh: 答案抽取与归一化会虚高分数

subfields.name: 🧮 Math RLVR datasets
subfields.focus: math records used for rejection sampling, SFT, PRMs, and RLVR
subfields.focus_zh: 用于拒绝采样、SFT、PRM 与 RLVR 的数学记录
subfields.key_risk: data reuse and contamination are not reported
subfields.key_risk_zh: 数据复用与污染情况未被报告

subfields.name: 💻 Code execution / unit-test data
subfields.focus: code problems, unit tests, generated tests, execution logs, and repair tasks
subfields.focus_zh: 代码题、单元测试、生成测试、执行日志与修复任务
subfields.key_risk: flaky or leaked tests become the reward
subfields.key_risk_zh: 不稳定或已泄漏的测试变成了奖励

subfields.name: 🧾 Formal proof / Lean / theorem proving
subfields.name_zh: 形式化证明与 Lean 定理证明
subfields.focus: Lean, proof scripts, tactic environments, theorem statements, and proof checkers
subfields.focus_zh: Lean、证明脚本、tactic 环境、定理陈述与证明检查器
subfields.key_risk: proof succeeds only under an undocumented environment
subfields.key_risk_zh: 证明只在未记录的环境下才成立

subfields.name: 🧪 Verifier robustness and answer extraction
subfields.name_zh: 验证器鲁棒性与答案抽取
subfields.focus: false positives, false negatives, checker brittleness, and adversarial formats
subfields.focus_zh: 假阳性、假阴性、检查器脆弱性与对抗性格式
subfields.key_risk: model learns verifier quirks instead of task skill
subfields.key_risk_zh: 模型学到的是验证器的怪癖而非任务能力

subfields.name: 🧰 Programmatic benchmarks
subfields.focus: evaluation sets whose scoring can become a post-training signal
subfields.focus_zh: 其评分可能被当作后训练信号的评测集
subfields.key_risk: benchmark scoring is reused as reward without audit
subfields.key_risk_zh: 基准评分未经审计就被复用为奖励

title: Process / Trace Supervision
summary: Step-level labels, process reward models, rollout values, first-error localization, automatic process supervision, and PRM evaluation.
summary_zh: 步骤级标注、过程奖励模型、rollout 价值、首错定位、自动过程监督，以及 PRM 评测。
reader_promise: Use this track to move from final-answer feedback to intermediate feedback attached to reasoning steps or trace states.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向从「只看最终答案的反馈」走到「附着在推理步骤或轨迹状态上的中间反馈」。

subfields.name: 🪜 Human step-level labels
subfields.focus: human-labeled intermediate steps and first-error annotations
subfields.focus_zh: 人工标注的中间步骤与首个错误位置
subfields.key_risk: step boundaries and label policy are ambiguous
subfields.key_risk_zh: 步骤边界与标注规范存在歧义

subfields.name: 🧪 Process reward models
subfields.focus: PRMs, process verifiers, calibration, and reward-model training
subfields.focus_zh: PRM、过程验证器、校准与奖励模型训练
subfields.key_risk: process reward rises while final correctness does not
subfields.key_risk_zh: 过程奖励上升而最终正确率并未提高

subfields.name: 🔁 Rollout-value supervision
subfields.focus: rollout values, search-derived labels, and automated progress signals
subfields.focus_zh: rollout 价值、搜索派生标签与自动进度信号
subfields.key_risk: rollout policy leaks solver strength into labels
subfields.key_risk_zh: 采样策略把求解器强度泄漏进标签

subfields.name: 🛠️ Automatic process supervision
subfields.focus: programmatic or model-generated process labels without dense human annotation
subfields.focus_zh: 无需密集人工标注的程序化或模型生成过程标签
subfields.key_risk: automatic labels silently inherit verifier bias
subfields.key_risk_zh: 自动标签会静默继承验证器偏差

subfields.name: ❌ First-error localization
subfields.focus: where a solution first becomes invalid and how that signal is used
subfields.focus_zh: 解法从哪一步开始失效，以及这个信号如何被使用
subfields.key_risk: localized errors are not causally linked to correction
subfields.key_risk_zh: 定位到的错误与后续纠正没有因果联系

subfields.name: 📊 PRM benchmarks and evaluation
subfields.focus: ProcessBench, PRMBench, Qwen PRM, and evaluation surfaces for process rewards
subfields.focus_zh: ProcessBench、PRMBench、Qwen PRM 及过程奖励的评测面
subfields.key_risk: PRM benchmark success does not transfer to training use
subfields.key_risk_zh: PRM 基准上的好成绩迁移不到训练用途

title: Rollout / Search / TTC Trace
title_zh: 采样、搜索与推理时轨迹数据
summary: Multiple rollouts, search trees, best-of-N samples, self-consistency traces, MCTS records, selected/rejected candidates, and test-time compute logs.
summary_zh: 多次采样、搜索树、best-of-N 样本、自一致性轨迹、MCTS 记录、被选中与被拒绝的候选，以及推理时计算日志。
reader_promise: Use this track when the important data is not one answer but a set of sampled attempts, search paths, selector scores, or inference-budget traces.
reader_promise_zh: 当关键数据不是一个答案，而是一组采样尝试、搜索路径、选择器分数或推理预算轨迹时，用这个方向。

subfields.name: 🎲 Multiple rollouts / best-of-N
subfields.focus: sets of sampled attempts and selected accepted answers
subfields.focus_zh: 多组采样尝试及最终被选中的答案
subfields.key_risk: only accepted traces are visible
subfields.key_risk_zh: 只有被接受的轨迹是可见的

subfields.name: 🌳 Search trees / MCTS
subfields.focus: tree search, MCTS, verifier-guided search, and path selection
subfields.focus_zh: 树搜索、MCTS、验证器引导搜索与路径选择
subfields.key_risk: tree policy or value model is hidden
subfields.key_risk_zh: 树搜索策略或价值模型被隐去

subfields.name: 🔎 Rejection sampling traces
subfields.focus: accepted and rejected candidates produced during filtering
subfields.focus_zh: 筛选过程中产生的被接受与被拒绝候选
subfields.key_risk: rejected examples are not released
subfields.key_risk_zh: 被拒绝的样本没有发布

subfields.name: 🧠 Self-consistency / repeated sampling
subfields.focus: vote-based or agreement-based reasoning from repeated samples
subfields.focus_zh: 基于投票或一致性的重复采样推理
subfields.key_risk: sampling budget is not comparable
subfields.key_risk_zh: 采样预算不可比

subfields.name: ⏱️ Test-time compute logs
subfields.focus: thinking budgets, inference-time scaling, and runtime search traces
subfields.focus_zh: 思考预算、推理时扩展与运行期搜索轨迹
subfields.key_risk: training and inference budget effects are conflated
subfields.key_risk_zh: 训练预算与推理预算的效应被混在一起

subfields.name: ✂️ Long2short / distill-from-search
subfields.focus: using long search traces to train shorter or cheaper behavior
subfields.focus_zh: 用长搜索轨迹训练更短、更省的行为
subfields.key_risk: teacher search artifacts become hidden data lineage
subfields.key_risk_zh: 教师的搜索痕迹变成了隐藏的数据谱系

title: Environment & Agent Trajectories
title_zh: 环境与智能体轨迹数据
summary: Tool calls, web/browser tasks, app and OS agents, repository-level SWE episodes, replayable trajectories, and terminal predicates.
summary_zh: 工具调用、网页与浏览器任务、应用与操作系统智能体、仓库级软件工程 episode、可回放轨迹与终止判定。
reader_promise: Use this track to understand how interactive environments become post-training data sources and feedback contracts.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向理解：交互式环境是如何变成后训练的数据来源与反馈契约的。

subfields.name: 🛠️ Tool-use data
subfields.focus: tool calls, function signatures, API banks, and tool-use traces
subfields.focus_zh: 工具调用、函数签名、API 库与工具使用轨迹
subfields.key_risk: tool schemas change or hide execution failures
subfields.key_risk_zh: 工具 schema 会变动，或掩盖执行失败

subfields.name: 🌍 Web/browser agents
subfields.focus: web tasks, browser state, navigation traces, and page observations
subfields.focus_zh: 网页任务、浏览器状态、导航轨迹与页面观测
subfields.key_risk: web state is not replayable after collection
subfields.key_risk_zh: 采集之后网页状态无法回放

subfields.name: 📱 App/mobile agents
subfields.focus: mobile apps, app-world tasks, UI actions, and user simulators
subfields.focus_zh: 移动应用、app-world 任务、UI 动作与用户模拟器
subfields.key_risk: UI state and app versions are not pinned
subfields.key_risk_zh: UI 状态与应用版本没有固定

subfields.name: 🖥️ OS/desktop agents
subfields.name_zh: 操作系统与桌面智能体
subfields.focus: desktop/OS tasks, filesystem state, shell actions, and multi-app workflows
subfields.focus_zh: 桌面/OS 任务、文件系统状态、shell 动作与多应用工作流
subfields.key_risk: hidden environment state makes episodes non-reproducible
subfields.key_risk_zh: 隐藏的环境状态使 episode 无法复现

subfields.name: 🧑‍💻 SWE/repository agents
subfields.name_zh: 软件工程与仓库级智能体
subfields.focus: GitHub issues, code patches, tests, commits, and repository repair episodes
subfields.focus_zh: GitHub issue、代码补丁、测试、提交与仓库修复 episode
subfields.key_risk: repository commit, tests, and scaffold are not pinned
subfields.key_risk_zh: 仓库提交、测试与脚手架没有固定版本

subfields.name: 🔁 Replayable trajectory data
subfields.focus: state-action-observation schemas, terminal predicates, and failure traces
subfields.focus_zh: 状态—动作—观测 schema、终止判定与失败轨迹
subfields.key_risk: success transcript cannot be replayed or audited
subfields.key_risk_zh: 成功的记录无法被回放或审计

subfields.name: 🧰 Agent benchmarks and terminal predicates
subfields.name_zh: 智能体基准与终止判定
subfields.focus: agent evaluation suites, task resets, terminal predicates, and success/failure labels
subfields.focus_zh: 智能体评测套件、任务重置、终止判定与成败标签
subfields.key_risk: score is reported without a replayable predicate
subfields.key_risk_zh: 报告了分数却没有可回放的判定条件

title: Judgment / Rubric / Domain Expert
title_zh: 评审、评分标准与领域专家数据
summary: LLM-as-judge data, human/expert judgment, medical and safety rubrics, factuality, legal and financial reasoning, and rubric reward models.
summary_zh: 大模型评审数据、人工与专家评判、医学与安全评分标准、事实性、法律与金融推理，以及评分标准奖励模型。
reader_promise: Use this track when correctness needs a rubric, expert judgment, grounding evidence, or calibrated evaluator rather than a cheap programmatic checker.
reader_promise_zh: 当正确性需要评分标准、专家判断、证据锚定或经过校准的评估者，而不是一个廉价的程序化检查器时，用这个方向。

subfields.name: ⚖️ LLM-as-judge data
subfields.focus: model judges, preference judgments, judge prompts, and evaluator models
subfields.focus_zh: 模型评审、偏好判定、评审提示词与评估模型
subfields.key_risk: judge is sensitive to style, position, or prompt attacks
subfields.key_risk_zh: 评审对文体、位置与提示词攻击敏感

subfields.name: 🧑‍⚖️ Human/expert judgment
subfields.focus: human labels, expert adjudication, disagreement handling, and rubric design
subfields.focus_zh: 人工标注、专家裁定、分歧处理与评分标准设计
subfields.key_risk: expertise and adjudication policy are not disclosed
subfields.key_risk_zh: 专业背景与裁定规范未被披露

subfields.name: 🩺 Medical reasoning / health rubrics
subfields.name_zh: 医学推理与健康评分标准
subfields.focus: health, biomedical, scientific, and evidence-grounded reasoning tasks
subfields.focus_zh: 健康、生物医学、科学与基于证据的推理任务
subfields.key_risk: rubrics are not calibrated for high-stakes error
subfields.key_risk_zh: 评分标准没有针对高风险错误做校准

subfields.name: 🛡️ Safety reasoning data
subfields.focus: safety reasoning, refusals, jailbreaks, harmfulness, and guardrail data
subfields.focus_zh: 安全推理、拒答、越狱、有害性与护栏数据
subfields.key_risk: safe-looking refusals replace correct domain reasoning
subfields.key_risk_zh: 看似安全的拒答取代了正确的领域推理

subfields.name: 🧾 Factuality / grounding
subfields.focus: claims, citations, retrieval grounding, fact checking, and evidence quality
subfields.focus_zh: 论断、引证、检索锚定、事实核查与证据质量
subfields.key_risk: citation style masks unsupported claims
subfields.key_risk_zh: 规范的引用格式会掩盖无支撑的论断

subfields.name: ⚖️ Legal reasoning
subfields.focus: legal QA, statutes, case reasoning, contracts, and expert legal rubrics
subfields.focus_zh: 法律问答、法条、判例推理、合同与专家法律评分标准
subfields.key_risk: splits leak templates or jurisdiction assumptions
subfields.key_risk_zh: 数据划分会泄漏模板或司法辖区假设

subfields.name: 🏦 Financial reasoning
subfields.focus: financial QA, tabular/text numerical reasoning, filings, and analyst-style judgments
subfields.focus_zh: 金融问答、表格与文本数值推理、财报与分析师式判断
subfields.key_risk: splits leak templates or memorized company facts
subfields.key_risk_zh: 数据划分会泄漏模板或被记住的公司事实

subfields.name: 🧪 Rubric reward models
subfields.focus: rubrics as trainable rewards and domain-conditioned reward models
subfields.focus_zh: 把 rubric 当作可训练奖励，以及领域条件化的奖励模型
subfields.key_risk: rubric scores are optimized without semantic robustness
subfields.key_risk_zh: rubric 分数被优化，却没有语义鲁棒性

title: Construction & Open Releases
summary: Prompt sourcing, teacher traces, rejection sampling, self-play, filtering, verifier refresh, open releases, lineage, and release metadata.
summary_zh: 题目来源、教师轨迹、拒绝采样、自我博弈、筛选、验证器刷新、开源发布、数据谱系与发布元数据。
reader_promise: Use this track to learn how reasoning datasets are actually built, filtered, packaged, and released.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向了解推理数据集在实践中究竟是怎么构建、筛选、打包和发布的。

subfields.name: 🧱 Prompt sourcing
subfields.focus: question pools, seed sources, licenses, difficulty, and base-model pass rates
subfields.focus_zh: 题库、种子来源、许可、难度与基座模型通过率
subfields.key_risk: prompt sources are mixed without attribution
subfields.key_risk_zh: 题目来源被混合使用且没有署名

subfields.name: ✍️ Teacher trace generation
subfields.focus: teacher models, trace policies, sampling settings, and distillation targets
subfields.focus_zh: 教师模型、轨迹策略、采样设置与蒸馏目标
subfields.key_risk: teacher identity or sampling protocol is hidden
subfields.key_risk_zh: 教师身份或采样协议被隐去

subfields.name: 🔎 Rejection sampling / search-generated data
subfields.name_zh: 拒绝采样与搜索生成数据
subfields.focus: candidate generation, search budget, filtering, and accepted/rejected examples
subfields.focus_zh: 候选生成、搜索预算、筛选与接受/拒绝样本
subfields.key_risk: only accepted traces are released
subfields.key_risk_zh: 只发布了被接受的轨迹

subfields.name: 🔁 Self-play / self-improvement
subfields.focus: self-improvement, co-evolution, generator-verifier cycles, and curricula
subfields.focus_zh: 自我改进、协同进化、生成器—验证器循环与课程设计
subfields.key_risk: feedback loop amplifies hidden shortcuts
subfields.key_risk_zh: 反馈回路会放大隐藏的捷径

subfields.name: 🧪 Filtering and verifier refresh
subfields.focus: answer filters, judge filters, decontamination, and verifier updates
subfields.focus_zh: 答案过滤、评审过滤、去污染与验证器更新
subfields.key_risk: filter thresholds become hidden objectives
subfields.key_risk_zh: 过滤阈值变成了隐性的优化目标

subfields.name: 🏗️ Open reasoning data releases
subfields.focus: open datasets, code, HF releases, recipes, ablations, and reproducibility
subfields.focus_zh: 开源数据集、代码、HF 发布、配方、消融与可复现性
subfields.key_risk: dataset is open but recipe details are not
subfields.key_risk_zh: 数据集开源了，但配方细节没有

subfields.name: 🧬 Data lineage and release metadata
subfields.name_zh: 数据谱系与发布元数据
subfields.focus: datasheets, splits, lineage, licensing, versioning, and known failures
subfields.focus_zh: datasheet、数据划分、谱系、许可、版本与已知失效
subfields.key_risk: reuse loses the release context
subfields.key_risk_zh: 复用时丢失了发布语境

title: Training Usage & Objectives
summary: How data enters SFT, distillation, preference optimization, reward modeling, PRM training, RLVR, agent training, evaluation, reranking, and audit.
summary_zh: 数据如何进入 SFT、蒸馏、偏好优化、奖励建模、PRM 训练、RLVR、智能体训练、评测、重排与审计。
reader_promise: Use this track to connect a data object to the objective or system component that consumes it.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向把一个数据对象，和真正消费它的训练目标或系统组件对应起来。

subfields.name: 🧱 SFT / instruction tuning
subfields.focus: data used as supervised target behavior
subfields.focus_zh: 被当作监督目标行为使用的数据
subfields.key_risk: target text hides verifier and source assumptions
subfields.key_risk_zh: 目标文本掩盖了验证器与来源假设

subfields.name: 📚 Distillation
subfields.focus: teacher outputs, traces, or policies distilled into a student
subfields.focus_zh: 教师的输出、轨迹或策略被蒸馏进学生模型
subfields.key_risk: teacher lineage is hidden
subfields.key_risk_zh: 教师谱系被隐去

subfields.name: ⚖️ Preference optimization
subfields.focus: pairwise feedback for DPO/IPO/KTO-style objectives
subfields.focus_zh: 用于 DPO/IPO/KTO 式目标的成对反馈
subfields.key_risk: pair context does not match downstream use
subfields.key_risk_zh: 偏好对的语境与下游用途不匹配

subfields.name: 🎚️ Reward modeling / ORM
subfields.focus: scalar or pairwise data used to train outcome rewards
subfields.focus_zh: 用于训练结果奖励的标量或成对数据
subfields.key_risk: reward can be overoptimized
subfields.key_risk_zh: 奖励可能被过度优化

subfields.name: 🪜 PRM / process supervision
subfields.focus: step-level or trace-level signals used to train process rewards
subfields.focus_zh: 用于训练过程奖励的步骤级或轨迹级信号
subfields.key_risk: PRM rewards trace style
subfields.key_risk_zh: PRM 奖励的其实是轨迹的文体

subfields.name: 🏋️ RLVR / verifier RL
subfields.name_zh: RLVR 与验证器强化学习
subfields.focus: programmatic or verifier rewards used in RL
subfields.focus_zh: 在强化学习中使用的程序化或验证器奖励
subfields.key_risk: verifier false positives become policy incentives
subfields.key_risk_zh: 验证器的假阳性变成了策略的激励

subfields.name: 🌐 Agent training
subfields.focus: environment episodes, tool traces, or terminal rewards for agent policies
subfields.focus_zh: 用于智能体策略的环境 episode、工具轨迹或终止奖励
subfields.key_risk: environment cannot be replayed
subfields.key_risk_zh: 环境无法回放

subfields.name: 🧪 Evaluation / reranking / audit
subfields.focus: data used for scoring, selection, reporting, or failure analysis
subfields.focus_zh: 用于打分、选择、报告或失效分析的数据
subfields.key_risk: evaluation data becomes training data
subfields.key_risk_zh: 评测数据变成了训练数据

title: Scaling / RLVR / TTC
title_zh: 规模化、RLVR 与推理时计算
summary: Data scaling, data reuse, RLVR optimization, verifier scaling, pass@k, sampling budgets, test-time compute, and scaling attribution.
summary_zh: 数据规模化、数据复用、RLVR 优化、验证器规模化、pass@k、采样预算、推理时计算与规模化归因。
reader_promise: Use this track to interpret claims about how much data, verifier strength, RL, and inference budget contribute to reasoning gains.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向解读各种主张：数据量、验证器强度、强化学习与推理预算，各自对推理能力提升贡献了多少。

subfields.name: 📈 Data scaling
subfields.focus: number, diversity, difficulty, and uniqueness of examples
subfields.focus_zh: 样本的数量、多样性、难度与唯一性
subfields.key_risk: unique examples and repeated rollouts are conflated
subfields.key_risk_zh: 唯一样本与重复采样被混为一谈

subfields.name: 🔁 Data reuse and uniqueness
subfields.focus: reuse counts, deduplication, repeated prompts, and train/test overlap
subfields.focus_zh: 复用次数、去重、重复题目与训练/测试重叠
subfields.key_risk: same source examples are counted as fresh data
subfields.key_risk_zh: 同一来源的样本被当成新数据计入

subfields.name: ⏱️ Test-time compute
subfields.focus: sampling, search, self-critique, thinking budgets, and inference-time scaling
subfields.focus_zh: 采样、搜索、自我批判、思考预算与推理时扩展
subfields.key_risk: different inference budgets are compared
subfields.key_risk_zh: 不同推理预算之间被直接比较

subfields.name: 🎲 pass@k / sampling budget
subfields.focus: pass@k, repeated sampling, best-of-N, and budget-aware evaluation
subfields.focus_zh: pass@k、重复采样、best-of-N 与考虑预算的评测
subfields.key_risk: reported gains hide selection or budget changes
subfields.key_risk_zh: 报告的提升掩盖了选择方式或预算变化

subfields.name: 🧪 Verifier scaling
subfields.focus: how verifier strength, refresh, and coverage scale with training
subfields.focus_zh: 验证器强度、刷新频率与覆盖面如何随训练一起扩展
subfields.key_risk: verifier becomes stale or easy to exploit
subfields.key_risk_zh: 验证器会过时或变得容易被利用

subfields.name: 🏋️ RLVR optimization scaling
subfields.focus: policy optimization, reward contracts, curriculum, and rollout policy
subfields.focus_zh: 策略优化、奖励契约、课程设计与 rollout 策略
subfields.key_risk: optimizer/scaffold gains are mistaken for data gains
subfields.key_risk_zh: 优化器或脚手架带来的收益被误记为数据收益

subfields.name: 🔍 Scaling attribution
subfields.focus: separating data, verifier, optimizer, model, and inference-budget effects
subfields.focus_zh: 把数据、验证器、优化器、模型与推理预算的效应分开
subfields.key_risk: ablation tables do not isolate the source of improvement
subfields.key_risk_zh: 消融表没有隔离出改进的真正来源

title: Benchmarks & Evaluation
summary: Math, code, proof, agent, rubric/domain, reward-model, live, hidden, and contamination-resistant benchmarks.
summary_zh: 数学、代码、证明、智能体、评分标准与领域、奖励模型、实时、隐藏，以及抗污染的各类基准。
reader_promise: Use this track to understand what an evaluation surface measures and whether it can safely become a feedback source.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向理解一个评测面到底测了什么，以及它能否安全地被当作反馈来源。

subfields.name: 📐 Math benchmarks
subfields.focus: math problem sets, answer extraction, verifier compatibility, and difficulty
subfields.focus_zh: 数学题集、答案抽取、验证器兼容性与难度
subfields.key_risk: short-answer normalization hides reasoning errors
subfields.key_risk_zh: 短答案归一化会掩盖推理错误

subfields.name: 💻 Code benchmarks
subfields.focus: coding tasks, generated tests, hidden tests, repair tasks, and live coding
subfields.focus_zh: 编码任务、生成测试、隐藏测试、修复任务与实时编码
subfields.key_risk: unit tests are brittle, leaked, or too narrow
subfields.key_risk_zh: 单元测试脆弱、已泄漏或覆盖过窄

subfields.name: 🧾 Proof benchmarks
subfields.focus: formal proof datasets, proof assistants, theorem statements, and checking
subfields.focus_zh: 形式化证明数据集、证明助手、定理陈述与检查
subfields.key_risk: proof checker version and imports are not pinned
subfields.key_risk_zh: 证明检查器版本与依赖导入没有固定

subfields.name: 🌐 Agent benchmarks
subfields.focus: web, tool, OS, app, and SWE environments with terminal predicates
subfields.focus_zh: 带终止判定的网页、工具、操作系统、应用与软件工程环境
subfields.key_risk: benchmark episodes cannot be replayed
subfields.key_risk_zh: 基准的 episode 无法回放

subfields.name: ⚖️ Rubric/domain benchmarks
subfields.focus: medical, safety, legal, finance, science, factuality, and expert rubrics
subfields.focus_zh: 医学、安全、法律、金融、科学、事实性与专家评分标准
subfields.key_risk: rubric or judge expertise is insufficiently disclosed
subfields.key_risk_zh: rubric 或评审者的专业背景披露不足

subfields.name: 🧪 Reward-model benchmarks
subfields.focus: reward model, LLM-judge, PRM, and rubric evaluation suites
subfields.focus_zh: 奖励模型、大模型评审、PRM 与 rubric 评测套件
subfields.key_risk: benchmark reward preference does not reflect training value
subfields.key_risk_zh: 基准上的奖励偏好不反映训练价值

subfields.name: 🧯 Live / contamination-resistant benchmarks
subfields.focus: live, refreshed, hidden, or contamination-aware evaluation
subfields.focus_zh: 实时、定期刷新、隐藏或考虑污染的评测
subfields.key_risk: static benchmark becomes a training target
subfields.key_risk_zh: 静态基准变成了训练目标

title: Frontier Disclosure Ledger
title_zh: 前沿模型报告与数据披露
summary: DeepSeek-R1, Kimi, Qwen, Magistral, Phi, Nemotron, RLVR reports, and what each frontier-style report discloses or hides about data.
summary_zh: DeepSeek-R1、Kimi、Qwen、Magistral、Phi、Nemotron 与各类 RLVR 报告，以及它们在数据上披露或隐去了什么。
reader_promise: Use this track to read frontier model reports as partial data-disclosure documents rather than only model-performance announcements.
reader_promise_zh: 用这个方向把前沿模型报告读成「部分数据披露文件」，而不只是性能发布公告。

subfields.name: 🚀 DeepSeek-R1 family
subfields.focus: RLVR, distillation, reasoning traces, and public recipe disclosure
subfields.focus_zh: RLVR、蒸馏、推理轨迹与公开配方披露
subfields.key_risk: report describes outcomes but not enough data partitions
subfields.key_risk_zh: 报告描述了结果，但数据分区披露不足

subfields.name: 🌙 Kimi reasoning reports
subfields.focus: long-context reasoning, RL compute, and frontier inference budgets
subfields.focus_zh: 长上下文推理、强化学习算力与前沿推理预算
subfields.key_risk: test-time compute is mixed with training-data effects
subfields.key_risk_zh: 推理时计算与训练数据的效应被混在一起

subfields.name: 🐉 Qwen reasoning/math/code reports
subfields.name_zh: Qwen 推理/数学/代码报告
subfields.focus: math, code, PRM, and open-weight reasoning model families
subfields.focus_zh: 数学、代码、PRM 与开放权重推理模型系列
subfields.key_risk: release cards do not separate SFT, RLVR, and evaluation data
subfields.key_risk_zh: 发布卡没有区分 SFT、RLVR 与评测数据

subfields.name: 🧠 Magistral / Phi / Nemotron style reports
subfields.focus: open-weight reasoning reports with partial data and reward disclosures
subfields.focus_zh: 部分披露数据与奖励的开放权重推理报告
subfields.key_risk: model-card claims cannot be mapped to concrete data objects
subfields.key_risk_zh: 模型卡的主张无法对应到具体数据对象

subfields.name: 🧪 RLVR recipe reports
subfields.focus: reports that expose reward contracts, rollout policies, or RL scaffolds
subfields.focus_zh: 披露奖励契约、rollout 策略或强化学习脚手架的报告
subfields.key_risk: RL gains are attributed without verifier coverage
subfields.key_risk_zh: 在验证器覆盖面不明的情况下就归因强化学习收益

subfields.name: 🧬 What is disclosed vs hidden
subfields.focus: data sources, filters, lineage, safety mixtures, and undisclosed partitions
subfields.focus_zh: 数据来源、过滤、谱系、安全混配与未披露分区
subfields.key_risk: opaque mixtures are reused as open recipes
subfields.key_risk_zh: 不透明的混配被当作开放配方复用

title: Audit & Failure Modes
summary: Benchmark contamination, search-time leakage, hidden lineage, reward hacking, verifier gaming, LLM-as-judge attacks, spurious rewards, and reproducibility failures.
summary_zh: 基准污染、检索期泄漏、隐藏谱系、奖励投机、验证器博弈、大模型评审攻击、虚假奖励与可复现性失效。
reader_promise: Use this track when you want to know how reasoning-data claims can fail and how to audit them before reuse.
reader_promise_zh: 当你想知道推理数据的结论会怎样失效、以及复用前该如何审计它时，用这个方向。

subfields.name: 🧯 Benchmark contamination
subfields.focus: train/test overlap, stale evaluations, and benchmark refresh
subfields.focus_zh: 训练/测试重叠、过时评测与基准刷新
subfields.key_risk: memorized items are reported as reasoning progress
subfields.key_risk_zh: 被记住的题目被当成推理能力的进步来报告

subfields.name: 🔍 Search-time contamination
subfields.focus: contamination introduced by search, tools, retrieval, or inference scaffolds
subfields.focus_zh: 由搜索、工具、检索或推理脚手架引入的污染
subfields.key_risk: test-time tool access leaks answer traces
subfields.key_risk_zh: 推理时的工具访问会泄漏答案轨迹

subfields.name: 🧬 Hidden lineage / teacher leakage
subfields.focus: teacher-model traces, synthetic data inheritance, and hidden trait transfer
subfields.focus_zh: 教师模型轨迹、合成数据继承与隐性特征传递
subfields.key_risk: student behavior inherits undisclosed teacher artifacts
subfields.key_risk_zh: 学生模型继承了未披露的教师痕迹

subfields.name: 🎮 Reward hacking
subfields.focus: ways reward models, tests, or judges can be optimized as shortcuts
subfields.focus_zh: 奖励模型、测试或评审可能被当作捷径优化的各种方式
subfields.key_risk: reward rises while real quality falls
subfields.key_risk_zh: 奖励上升而真实质量下降

subfields.name: 🧪 Verifier gaming
subfields.focus: models exploiting checkers, answer formats, or judge blind spots
subfields.focus_zh: 模型利用检查器、答案格式或评审盲区
subfields.key_risk: verifier-passing examples are semantically wrong
subfields.key_risk_zh: 通过验证器的样本在语义上其实是错的

subfields.name: ⚖️ LLM-as-judge attacks
subfields.focus: one-token attacks, position bias, verbosity bias, and prompt attacks
subfields.focus_zh: 单 token 攻击、位置偏差、冗长偏差与提示词攻击
subfields.key_risk: judge score changes for non-semantic reasons
subfields.key_risk_zh: 评审分数因与语义无关的原因而改变

subfields.name: 🧨 Spurious rewards
subfields.focus: shortcut rewards, memorization-triggered rewards, and wrong-behavior correlations
subfields.focus_zh: 捷径奖励、由记忆触发的奖励与错误行为的相关性
subfields.key_risk: reward improves while model learns a shortcut
subfields.key_risk_zh: 奖励在提升，模型学到的却是捷径

subfields.name: 📉 Reproducibility failures
subfields.focus: decoding, evaluation, scaffold, and data reporting failures
subfields.focus_zh: 解码、评测、脚手架与数据报告层面的失效
subfields.key_risk: reported gains disappear under controlled reruns
subfields.key_risk_zh: 在受控重跑下报告的收益消失了
